subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The article ______ several experts on the subject.
solution: The correct answer is **"cites."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Cites"** is the correct verb to use in this sentence to indicate that the article is referencing or quoting several experts on the subject. (उदाहरण या प्रमाणस्‍वरूप किसी बात का उल्‍लेख करना या किसी व्‍यक्ति के मूल शब्‍द उद्धृत करना) • **Example**: *She **cited**__ a passage from the President’s speech.* • The correct answer is Option 2. **Correct sentence**: *The article __**cites**__ several experts on the subject.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • The past tense of **"cite"** is **"cited"**, and the present participle is **"citing"**. • **"Sights"** refers to the act of seeing or pointing out something visually. (दृष्टि, नजर; देखने की क्षमता) • **"Sites"** refers to locations or places. (वह स्‍थान जहाँ कोई इमारत खड़ी थी, है या होगी; भवन स्‍थल) • **"Sits"** refers to the act of resting or being in a seated position. (बैठना, कुरसी आदि पर नितंबों के बल टिकना) 30:Tada, The correct answer is **"ran into."**
